hypothesis_text: Dynamic SBG's behavioral-equivalence detection generalizes across programming languages (at minimum Python <-> Java).
pre_registered_criterion: Statistically powered comparison (target N and power per docs/v2/H11_CROSS_LANGUAGE_DESIGN.md) showing dynamic SBG AUROC improvement over static SBG across at least one real cross-language pair set.

key_numbers.proxy_interpretation: not statistically meaningful; reported only as a lower-bound diagnostic, not as evidence of cross-language generalization

statistical_reconciliation.survives_correction: not applicable - underpowered, no significance claim made

notes: No real Java or JavaScript execution ever occurred. The 'language agnostic' claim explicitly prohibited from being drawn from 10-15 examples per Phase 4 mandate; this prohibition is honored here.
